messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: kv_cache_frag_rate spiked above 0.65 on fleet kv-prod-3 at 2759991111.03 — multiple cudaMalloc failures observed. Pager sent to oncall.
Priya (oncall): ack. I'm taking this — switching my status to paged. Starting triage.
Priya (oncall): initial symptom: latency climb -> token generation stalls -> 502s for realtime-gen routes. Metrics: kv.arena.free_ratio down to 0.02, kv.contbatch.inflight_batches steady + sudden growth in avg_batch_size.
Jake_R (eng-runtime): on it. any recent batch config rollouts? I see a config change 2759989000 that bumped max_batch_tokens from 1024 -> 4096 for a subset of customers.
Marta_SRE: confirmed: 12 customers show > 50% error spikes. Support ticket 9982 opened. Tony, can you reach out to top affected customers?
Tony (support): pinging affected accounts now. Short msg sent to Customer A and Customer B — letting them know we have an active mitigation.
Priya (oncall): logs show repeated stack traces with "cudaMalloc failed: out of memory" coming from kv_arena_alloc. Attaching a short sample:```
[2026-03-15T04:12:08Z] runtime: kv_arena.cpp:line 418 allocate() -> cudaMalloc(ptr=0x0, bytes=124416000) -> failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15T04:12:09Z] runtime: continuous_batcher.cpp:line 257 flush() -> batch tokens 3820 -> split
```
Jake_R (eng-runtime): that matches fragmentation — lots of small free blocks but no contiguous runs for large allocations. The 4k max_batch_tokens made bursts that required large contiguous KV pages.
Priya (oncall): mitigation options: 1) rollback batch config for the flagged tenant set, 2) trigger arena compaction job, 3) reduce concurrency on kv-prod-3, 4) route traffic to fallback smaller model variant. Thoughts?
Jake_R (eng-runtime): prioritize rollback + compaction. Rollback first to stop new pressure. I'll prepare a hotfix.
Marta_SRE: I'll queue a compaction run but it's invasive — will cause short CPU spikes on the host. We should do it on nodes with lower customer impact first.
Priya (oncall): @deploy-bot can we roll back the batch config for the cohort changed at 2759989000? Targeting cohort id: cohort-78.
deploy-bot: Received request to rollback config cohort-78. Initiating config rollback to version v3.2.1. Starting canary on 2 hosts.
Priya (oncall): canary looks ok on host-23 and host-41 — no crash. Proceed to fleet.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed for cohort-78 across kv-prod-3. Propagated in 35s. :white_check_mark:
Priya (oncall): rolling traffic now to fallback variant gptx-small for realtime-gen until compaction completes. This reduces per-request KV footprint.
Jake_R (eng-runtime): starting arena compaction: `redwoodctl infra run compaction --pool kv-prod-3 --mode staggered --chunk-size 64MB` — will run across 10 hosts sequentially to avoid cluster-wide impact. Expect each host compaction ~30-45s.
Marta_SRE: compaction job started on host-12. Monitoring mem and cuda metrics.
Priya (oncall): metrics: kv.arena.free_ratio rising on host-12 -> 0.15, cudaMalloc failures dropping. 502 rate for realtime-gen down from 12% -> 3% in the canary region.
Tony (support): customers reporting fewer errors; Customer A confirms degraded but usable. Keeping them updated.
Jake_R (eng-runtime): also applying temporary allocator tuning: set PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=garbage_collection_threshold:0.6,allocator_round_size:2097152 on workers with the compaction applied. This smooths allocation sizes and reduces fragmentation.
Priya (oncall): change applied to hosts 12/20. Observed immediate improvement in fragmentation metrics for those hosts.
Marta_SRE: compaction finished for hosts 12, 14, 19. Starting final sweep. No node reboots required.
Priya (oncall): last: confirm rollback completed, compaction progress 10/10, allocator env var applied cluster-wide via staged deploy. Moving traffic back slowly to default model variant.
Jake_R (eng-runtime): post-mortem notes to capture: avoid aggressive max_batch_tokens bumps without KV memory upper bound checks; add preflight safety that rejects config if projected_contiguous_alloc > X; add automated compaction trigger when free_ratio < 0.05 and fragmentation_growth > 0.2.
Marta_SRE: will open incident doc and link to alerts: alert id INC-2759991111. Also schedule a follow-up runbook update for compaction playbook.
Priya (oncall): closing the page — we'll keep monitoring for 2 hours. Thanks all. :hammer_and_wrench:
